name: Addendum Tax Type 4 Code
definition: Specifies the specific type of tax applicable to a transaction.

ALMI.name: Alternative Minimum Tax
ALMI.definition: Tax is an alternative minimum tax.

BPTX.name: Business Privilege Tax
BPTX.definition: Tax imposed on non-American Indian businesses for the privilege of conducting business on an American Indian Reservation

KAPA.name: Capital Gain Tax
KAPA.definition: Tax is on a capital gain (realised and unrealised), that is, the profit that is gained from the sale of a financial instrument.

NKAP.name: Capital Loss Credit
NKAP.definition: Tax recovery is due to capital loss.

CRTX.name: City Rental Tax
CRTX.definition: Levied by a city government against the periodic fee paid by a customer in return for the right to use the property of another party.

CSTX.name: City Sales Tax
CSTX.definition: Sales tax imposed by a city

CITX.name: City Tax
CITX.definition: Service tax imposed by a city

COAX.name: Consumption Tax
COAX.definition: Tax that is levied on goods and services purchased by customers, and is added to the retail price.

CPST.name: County Parish Sales Tax
CPST.definition: Service tax imposed by a County or Parish

CORT.name: County Rental Tax
CORT.definition: Levied by a county government against the periodic fee paid by a customer in return for the right to use the property of another party.

COTX.name: County Tax
COTX.definition: Service tax levied by a county

CUST.name: Customs Tax
CUST.definition: Tax levied on imports or exports by a country's customs authority.

DUTY.name: Duty
DUTY.definition: A tax levied on goods that typically though not exclusively transit across a geographic border.

EMIT.name: Emergency Assistance City Tax
EMIT.definition: Tax levied by a city to recover the cost of providing telephone emergency assistance service (for example, 112, 911, 999).

EMUT.name: Emergency Assistance County Tax
EMUT.definition: Tax levied by a county to recover the cost of providing telephone emergency assistance service (for example, 112, 911, 999).

EMET.name: Emergency Assistance Excise Tax
EMET.definition: Usage tax levied to recover the cost of telephone emergency assistance service (for example, 112, 911, 999).

EMST.name: Emergency Assistance State Tax
EMST.definition: Tax levied by a state to recover the cost of providing telephone emergency assistance service (for example, 112, 911, 999).

EMRT.name: Emergency Assistance Tax
EMRT.definition: Tax levied to recover the cost of providing telephone emergency assistance service (for example,112, 911, 999).

ENTX.name: Energy Tax
ENTX.definition: Tax applied to the utility and petroleum industries.

ESET.name: Enhanced Emergency Assistance State Excise Tax
ESET.definition: Tax levied by a state to recover the cost of providing enhanced telephone emergency assistance services (for example, 112, 911, 999) such as automatic call identification.

ENVT.name: Environmental Tax
ENVT.definition: Tax levied on activities which are considered to have negative impacts on an environment.

EQUL.name: Equalisation
EQUL.definition: Part of an investor's subscription amount that is held by the fund in order to pay incentive / performance fees at the end of the fiscal year.

EUTR.name: EU Tax Retention
EUTR.definition: Tax withheld at source in the framework of the European Directive on taxation of savings in the form of interest payments.

FEXT.name: Federal Excise Tax
FEXT.definition: Excise tax levied by a federal government.

FETX.name: Federal Tax
FETX.definition: Usage tax levied by federal (US and Canadian) government.

FVTS.name: Federal Value Added Tax On Services

FIMT.name: FICA Medicare Tax
FIMT.definition: USA Federal Insurance Contributions Act tax levied to assist in the funding of Medicare.

FSST.name: FICA Social Security Tax
FSST.definition: USA Federal Insurance Contributions Act tax levied to assist in the funding of social security.

FICA.name: FICA Tax
FICA.definition: USA Federal Insurance Contributions Act tax.

FRTX.name: Franchise Tax
FRTX.definition: Tax levied by a municipality, on certain types of businesses for the right to exist as a legal entity and conduct business in a particular jurisdiction.

FSFT.name: Fuel Super Fund Tax
FSFT.definition: USA federal tax levied on certain types of businesses to provide funding for cleanup of hazardous waste sites.

FUVT.name: Full VAT
FUVT.definition: Value Added Tax calculated at the full tax rate.

GIFT.name: Gift Tax
GIFT.definition: Tax that is levied on assets given to individuals prior to the death of the donor. Gift tax is designed to ensure the integrity of the inheritance tax, preventing the pre-death transfer of wealth.

GCAT.name: Goods And Services Tax
GCAT.definition: Goods and Services Tax - Canadian value-added tax.

HVAT.name: Half VAT
HVAT.definition: Value Added Tax calculated at the half tax rate.

HATX.name: Handicap Tax
HATX.definition: Tax assessed to assist the handicapped.

HWTX.name: Hazardous Waste Tax
HWTX.definition: Tax levied on entities that produce, store, treat, transport or otherwise manage hazardous wastes and materials.

INHT.name: Inheritance Tax
INHT.definition: Tax that is payable at the time of death on any items (money or otherwise), where ownership changes either upon death or within a legally specified number of years before death.

INPO.name: Interim Profit Tax
INPO.definition: Tax levied on the sum of all earnings/revenues accrued since the last dividend distribution.

FLST.name: Leaky Underground Storage Tank Tax
FLST.definition: Federal tax levied in the USA to fund the clean-up activities associated with leaking underground storage tanks.

LITX.name: License Tax
LITX.definition: Tax levied by a government agency for the granting of a license to conduct an activity, such as driving a car, operating a business, selling liquor, hunting, or practicing certain vocations.

LSTX.name: Local Sales Tax
LSTX.definition: All applicable sales taxes levied by taxing authorities below the state level. Used only for sales tax.

LOCL.name: Local Tax
LOCL.definition: Service tax levied by a local government or taxation agency. Not a sales tax.

LUTX.name: Luxury Tax
LUTX.definition: Ad valorem tax levied on products or services that are deemed to be non-essential or unneeded.

MUTX.name: Municipal Tax
MUTX.definition: Service tax imposed by a municipality.

COUN.name: National Federal Tax
COUN.definition: Tax is a country, national, or federal tax usually levied by the custodian.

OCTX.name: Occupancy Tax
OCTX.definition: Tax levied for the privelage of occupying space for home or rental for a fixed period of time, as determined by a taxing authority.

OPTX.name: Occupational Tax
OPTX.definition: Type of gross receipts tax imposed for the privilege of carrying on a business, trade or profession.

OTHR.name: Other
OTHR.definition: Other type of tax not elsewhere classified.

PSTX.name: Product And Services Tax
PSTX.definition: Tax levied on products and services

PPTX.name: Property Tax
PPTX.definition: Ad valorem property tax levied on real or personal property by local government units such as counties, municipalities, school districts, and special taxing districts.

PHET.name: Public Health And Education Tax
PHET.definition: Canadian tax levied to fund public care and education.

SAUT.name: Sales And Use Tax
SAUT.definition: Tax levied for the use of equipment and service provided

SCTX.name: School Tax
SCTX.definition: Tax levied by taxing authority for schools

STAM.name: Stamp Duty
STAM.definition: Tax levied on certain types of documents and transactions.

SLTX.name: State And Local Tax
SLTX.definition: State and local tax levies, exclusive of state and local sales tax.

SETX.name: State Excise Tax
SETX.definition: Usage tax imposed by state or provincial government authorities.

STPT.name: State Or Provincial Tax
STPT.definition: Sales tax levied by a State or Province that excludes sales or excise taxes.

SPTS.name: State Or Provincial Tax On Services
SPTS.definition: State or Provincial tax on services

SPTG.name: State Provincial Tax On Goods
SPTG.definition: State or Provincial Tax on Goods

SRTX.name: State Rental Tax
SRTX.definition: Tax levied by a state government against a periodic fee paid by a customer in return for the right to use the property of another party.

STEX.name: Stock Exchange Tax
STEX.definition: Tax levied by a stock exchange.

CTAX.name: Tax Credit
CTAX.definition: Direct reduction of an individual's tax liability.

TDDT.name: TDD Service Excise Tax
TDDT.definition: Excise tax levied to recover the cost of providing Telecommunications Device for the Deaf (TDD) Equipment.

TELT.name: Telecommunications Tax
TELT.definition: Tax levied on telecommunications companies for the right to provide services. May be a usage or excise tax.

UUTX.name: Utility Users Tax
UUTX.definition: Tax levied on consumers by a city or county for the use of natural gas.

VATB.name: Value Added Tax Of Zero Rate
VATB.definition: Tax for which a zero rate applies.

WTAX.name: Wealth Tax
WTAX.definition: Tax levied only when the value of assets or categories of assets owned by an entity are above a given limit as defined by the tax authority. Wealth tax is not linked to income.

WITF.name: Withholding Of Foreign Tax
WITF.definition: Rate at which the income will be withheld by the jurisdiction in which the income was originally paid, for which relief at source and/or reclaim may be possible.

WITL.name: Withholding Of Local Tax
WITL.definition: Rate at which the income will be withheld by the jurisdiction in which the account owner is located, for which relief at source and/or reclaim may be possible.

WITH.name: Withholding Tax
WITH.definition: Income tax withheld or deducted from the amount due to the recipient, and paid to the government by the payer rather than the recipient. May apply to salaries, interest, and other types of proceeds.
